content: June 27, 2026: the system introduced automated monthly memory consolidation to summarize and prune past data, improving long-term storage efficiency and reducing latency.
June 29, 2026: Aiko-chan’s WebUI transitioned to the AikoWeb backend, replacing the TUI interface with browser-based UI and enabling real-time mouth animation via viseme callbacks.

June 26, 2026: the agentic routing system underwent a major overhaul with Harrier embeddings, monthly consolidation, and latency telemetry to refine intent classification and tool invocation precision.
June 30, 2026: weekly social-memory scheduling was introduced, including postcard drafting workflows and automated weekly reflections to enhance user interaction patterns.
June 25, 2026: remote browser audio playback was implemented via streaming WAV chunks, enabling seamless real-time voice synthesis in the WebUI without TUI dependency.
